CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit
    Dim strRefNo As String


Private Sub account_code_AfterUpdate()
    If IsNull([Account_Code]) Then
        Beep
        MsgBox "This Accounting Code does not exist. Please change it or add a new one.", vbCritical, "Accounting Code"
        DoCmd.CancelEvent
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub Account_Code_Exit(Cancel As Integer)
    CalcTotals
    
    If IsNull(transaction_reference) Or IsNull(Date) Or IsNull(Account_Code) Then
        Beep
        MsgBox "You have missing data!", vbCritical, "Missing Data"
        transaction_reference.SetFocus
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub cmdExit_Click()
    DoCmd.Close
End Sub

Private Sub cmdFindRecord_AfterUpdate()
    ' Find the record that matches the control.
    Dim rs As Object

    Set rs = Me.Recordset.Clone
    rs.FindFirst "transaction_reference = '" & Me!cmdFindRecord & "'"
    If Not rs.EOF Then Me.Bookmark = rs.Bookmark

End Sub

Private Sub Form_AfterDelConfirm(Status As Integer)
    FindNextRef
    Me!transaction_reference.DefaultValue = "'" & strRefNo & "'"
    Me.Refresh
End Sub

Private Sub Form_BeforeDelConfirm(Cancel As Integer, Response As Integer)
    Me!transaction_reference.DefaultValue = ""
    Me.Refresh
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
    Dim intnewrec As Integer
    intnewrec = Forms![Transactions].NewRecord
      
    If accounts_locked = True Then
        With Forms("transactions")
            .AllowDeletions = False
            .AllowEdits = False
            .record_locked_lable.Visible = True
        End With
    End If

    If accounts_locked = False Or intnewrec = True Then
        With Forms("transactions")
            .AllowDeletions = True
            .AllowEdits = True
            .record_locked_lable.Visible = False
        End With
    End If
    
    CalcTotals
    FindNextRef
    Me!transaction_reference.DefaultValue = "'" & strRefNo & "'"
End Sub

Private Sub ledger_accounts_Click()
    Dim DocName As String

    DocName = "ledger_accounts"
    DoCmd.OpenForm DocName
End Sub

Private Sub lock_accounts_Click()
    Dim DocName As String

    DocName = "lock_records"
    DoCmd.OpenForm DocName
End Sub

Private Sub payee_code_AfterUpdate()
    If IsNull([Payee_Code]) Then
        DoCmd.GoToControl "[Payee_Name]"
    End If
        
    If Not IsNull([Payee_Code]) Then
        Payee_Name = UCase(Payee_Name)
        [Payee_Name] = DLookup("[Payee_Name]", "[quick_codes]", "[Payee_Code]=Forms![Transactions].[Payee_Code]")
        [Account_Code] = DLookup("[Auto_Code]", "[quick_codes]", "[Payee_Code]=Forms![Transactions].[Payee_Code]")
        DoCmd.GoToControl "[account_code]"
        Me.Refresh
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub payment_receipt_change()

    If Payment_receipt = "Receipt" Then
        Payment = Null
    ElseIf Payment_receipt = "Payment" Then
        Receipt = Null
    End If
    
    Me.Refresh
    CalcTotals
End Sub

Private Sub quick_codes_Click()
    Dim DocName As String
    
    DocName = "Quick Codes"
    DoCmd.OpenForm DocName
End Sub


Private Sub Total_AfterUpdate()
    CalcTotals
End Sub

Private Sub transaction_reference_Exit(Cancel As Integer)
    Dim rstme As DAO.Recordset
    Dim strsql As String

    strsql = "SELECT transaction_reference FROM transactions where transaction_reference = '" & Forms!Transactions!transaction_reference & "'"
    Set rstme = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strsql)

    If rstme.RecordCount > 0 And Me.NewRecord Then
        MsgBox "The reference you have entered all ready exists. Please update the existing one or enter another reference number."
        DoCmd.CancelEvent
        transaction_reference = Null
        transaction_reference.SetFocus
    End If

End Sub

Private Sub transactions_report_Click()
    Dim DocName As String

    DocName = "TransactionsDialogBox"
    DoCmd.OpenForm DocName
End Sub

Public Sub CalcTotals()
    Dim rstme As DAO.Recordset
    Dim strsql As String
    Dim dblGST As Double
    Dim intTransactionDate As Long
    
    'find GST percentage based on transaction date
    If Not IsNull(Me!transaction_date) Then
        intTransactionDate = Me!transaction_date
        strsql = "SELECT GSTRate FROM GST_rates where " & intTransactionDate & " >= GSTStartDate and " & intTransactionDate & " <= GSTEndDate"
        Set rstme = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strsql)
        dblGST = 1.15
'        dblGST = 1 + rstme("GSTRate")

        lblGSTPercent.Caption = "(" + Trim(Str((dblGST - 1) * 100)) + "%)"
    
        'update totals
        Me.Refresh
        If (Payment_receipt = "Receipt") Then
            Gross_Total = transaction_total
            GST_Total = transaction_total - (transaction_total / dblGST)
            Receipt = transaction_total
            Payment = Null
        ElseIf (Payment_receipt = "Payment") Then
            Gross_Total = transaction_total * -1
            GST_Total = (transaction_total - (transaction_total / dblGST)) * -1
            Payment = transaction_total * -1
            Receipt = Null
        End If
        
        If (DLookup("[GST_exempt]", "[ledger_accounts]", "[Account_Code]=Forms![Transactions].[Account_Code]") = True) Then
            GST_Total = 0
            lblGSTPercent.Caption = "(0%)"
        End If
        Me.Refresh
    End If

    FindNextRef
End Sub
Public Sub FindNextRef()
    Dim strRefNoPart1 As String
    Dim strRefNoPart2 As String
    Dim intTransactionID As Long
    Dim intCounter As Long
    
    Dim rstme As DAO.Recordset
    Dim strsql As String

    strsql = "select max(transaction_id) as max_trans_ID from transactions where transaction_reference like 'bk*'"
    Set rstme = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strsql)
    
    intTransactionID = rstme("max_trans_ID")
    rstme.Close
    Set rstme = Nothing
    
    strsql = "select transaction_reference from transactions where transaction_id = " & intTransactionID & ""
    Set rstme = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strsql)

    strRefNo = rstme("transaction_reference")
    strRefNoPart1 = Left([strRefNo], InStr([strRefNo], "-") - 1)
    strRefNoPart2 = Right([strRefNo], Len([strRefNo]) - InStr([strRefNo], "-"))
    intCounter = Int(strRefNoPart2)
    intCounter = intCounter + 1
    strRefNo = strRefNoPart1 + "-" + Format(Str(intCounter), "00")
End Sub
